scope: pre-registration of the second canonical-test session (PNAS integration steps 13-14); written before any test row is read
authoritative_baseline: Published/supplied-checkpoint AdarEdit canonical-test benchmark at upstream 5c8b57d70cdc2eb1c5e168431013275bcc9ed0c5 (as provenance/model_selection_policy.json)
canonical_test_rule: Second evaluation of the canonical test. The first, of PNAS's selected predictor on 2026-08-25, is recorded in provenance/test_quarantine.json. Every model below was chosen on development data only; the headline is named here, before the session, so the test ranks and never picks. All models are scored once, in a single session, under a successor quarantine policy (provenance/test_quarantine_v2.json) that continues PNAS's audit chain.

development_selection_result.cnn_fix: the target/helix-partner window uses the opposite-base partner lane (partner_lane = opposite)
development_selection_result.second_network: graph + CNN alone, selected over graph + hybrid by a rule fixed before the runs (tie -> the simpler network, AUROC decides; 5 development runs x 5 endpoints)
development_selection_result.gap_stage: L2 logistic on (graph log-odds, CNN-alone log-odds, log1p genomic gap); PNAS's gate scheme; kept because, on 5 development runs, the gap beat both the no-gap and the shuffled-gap stage and the gap stage beat the equal average, all by rules fixed before the run
development_selection_result.averaging: each network averaged over its 5 seeds in log-odds, then one gap stage per endpoint
development_selection_result.final_fitting_protocol: PNAS's: each network trained on expanded high/low observations from the published train pairs, epoch and threshold selected on published validation, 1000 epochs; the stage fitted on published train canonical rows, its penalty and F1 threshold chosen on published validation
development_selection_result.decision_record: pnas_integration DECISIONS.md D29/D33 (second network), D39/D40/D43 (gap stage), D44/D45 (final fitting, averaging), D6/D14 (test framing)

evaluation_plan.headline: gap_stage

comparators.equal_average: the frozen equal log-odds average of the same ten final models (models/final_v2/equal_average/<endpoint>/, its validation threshold)
comparators.pnas_selected_predictor: PNAS's selected predictor (graph + old hybrid, equal logits) as scored in its consumed evaluation (results/adarpro/final_locked_test/), checked against its published metrics before use
comparators.adaredit_reference: the reproduced supplied-checkpoint AdarEdit baseline, scored and checked exactly as PNAS did (results/adarpro/baseline_reproduction.csv)

evaluation_plan.intervals: pair-clustered bootstrap (whole pairs with all their sites), 95% percentile interval
evaluation_plan.bootstrap_seed: 20260821 + the endpoint's index in (Artery, Brain, Liver, MuscleSkeletal, Combined), PNAS's seeds, so every contrast uses the same resamples as PNAS's own
evaluation_plan.thresholds: frozen from validation; nothing is re-thresholded except PNAS's descriptive matched-recall analysis
evaluation_plan.summary_across_endpoints: mean of the five per-endpoint point differences, as PNAS's macro values
evaluation_plan.downstream: PNAS's final_figures on the headline vs AdarEdit: error transitions (false-positive rescue, true-positive damage), matched recall with its pair bootstrap, ROC/PR curves, calibration (paper Fig. 4, Figs. S5-S6, Tables S1 and S9)

interpretation_rules: A contrast is 'better' only where its whole 95% interval lies above zero (below zero for Brier), 'worse' only where it lies on the other side, and otherwise 'cannot be told apart on the test'; never 'equivalent'.
The headline stays the headline whatever the comparators show; no model, threshold, weight or stage is changed after the session.
Headline vs AdarEdit carries PNAS's test claims (AUROC, AUPRC, F1 per endpoint with intervals; Brier); where a number contradicts a sentence, the sentence takes the smallest change.
Headline vs PNAS's selected predictor and headline vs equal average are reported per endpoint as measured; the intervals condition on the fitted models and do not include retraining variability.
failure_rule: If any check inside the session fails (row alignment, the AdarEdit or PNAS reproduction, the label-free gap lookup, the pair or BED-row disjointness), its outputs are not used and Eli is told; another attempt would be a further evaluation of the same test, run only on his explicit OK and recorded as such.
